_comment: Jodi voice agent - language switch is a Sarvam CORE tool, enabled automatically when 'Switch language during call' is on in Settings > Language personalisation. There is nothing to author as an API tool; this file records the settings and the usage rule.
name: language_switch

settings.switch_after: short delay; start with the dashboard default and tune after test calls (value not documented)
settings.output_numbers_in_indic: test both; start OFF so BP and weights are read as plain digits (e.g. '150 over 100'), turn ON if Kannada/Hindi listeners understand Indic number reading better
settings.per_language_voices: optional; if enabled, map Kannada, Hindi and English to calm, warm female Bulbul V4 voices (the speaker stays fixed for the call even after a switch)

description: Changes the language Jodi speaks mid-call. Use it when the speaker clearly changes language (for example, the mother starts speaking Hindi), when the caller asks for another language, or at the start of the call if {{language}} is hi or en while the call started in Kannada. Mirror light code-mixing (Kannada with English words) without switching.
notes: Source: https://docs.sarvam.ai/voice-agents/build/tools/core-tools.md and conversation-settings.md. The docs list it as a built-in tool; they do not document its parameters or a name to reference in the instruction (call transfer is referenced as call_transfer; the language-switch tool name is not given). Check the Tools tab after enabling and use the name shown there.

For outbound calls the backend can set the starting language per call via Instant Outbound app_overrides.initial_language_name ('Kannada' | 'Hindi' | 'English'), so a Hindi-speaking mother hears Hindi from the first word.
The greeting is not generated by the LLM; it is played from a per-language translation, so add kn, hi and en greeting translations (voice/agent.md section 2).
